svg.aria-label: Daily doodle for September 1, 2026 — the 167th anniversary of the Carrington Event geomagnetic storm. On the left half, a large glowing sun in the upper-left with a swirling corona hurls a warm plasma arc across the sky; gold particles streak from left to right toward a small blue Earth in the upper mid-right, which is wrapped in rippling green and violet auroral curtains that drape from top to horizon; below, silhouetted dark hills carry two telegraph poles, a sagging wire strung between them, and bright cyan-white sparks flashing along the wire from the induced current. On the right, a huge cream SEPTEMBER 1, 2026 headline underlined by a green-to-violet aurora sweep, a green CARRINGTON EVENT · 167 YEARS subhead trailed by cream · SINCE 1859, an italic aurora-violet REDHILL · SOLAR FLARE · TELEGRAPHS · AURORAE tertiary, a dim cyan CUBA · HAWAII · COLOMBIA · QUEENSLAND roster, and a Georgia-italic 'aurorae seen from the equator.' caption at the base.
